Hey, our team just finished a batch of changes to the payment-service microservice and we need a thorough code review before we merge to production. There are changes in the `src/api/charge.py` and `src/utils/fee_calculator.py` files, and some test file changes too — you can figure out exactly what changed by looking at the git history in `/workspace/payment-service`.

We're especially worried about whether this is safe to ship — there have been some security incidents at competitors recently. We also want to know if the refactoring effort is actually worth it (is the cost of the change justified by the benefit?), and we need an overall quality score for the changes.

Please produce a complete review report and save it as `code_review_report.md` in the `/workspace/payment-service` directory.
